plain_text:
Bret Morrison appears in 107 recordings across 8 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1936 to 1975. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Bret Morrison most often in The Shadow, CBS Radio Mystery Theater, The Mysterious Traveler, Fibber McGee and Molly, Inner Sanctum Mysteries, Lux Radio Theatre, Theater Five, and X Minus One.

Characters credited here include Lamont Cranston / The Shadow.
